name: Hire a Human
description: Create human freelance tasks through Hire a Human. This connector exposes task creation only. Hiring uses funded escrow, not a native percentage-of-sale commission workflow; task lookup, messaging, and payment API routes are not publicly documented.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Hire a Human API Key
credential_fields.description: Create a key in https://hire-a-human.ai/dashboard/ai-agent after identity verification. Task creation requires the write scope. Use a provider API key, not a Supabase project key.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task using the provider-native JSON payload for POST /api-tasks. The provider describes a title, description, offered rate, deadline, and target type (ai, human, or both), but does not publish a full field schema. Supply the exact request object from your provider API documentation; it is forwarded unchanged. No idempotency or cancellation contract is documented.

task.description: Exact Hire a Human task-creation JSON body. Obtain the current required field names and constraints from the provider; nested fields are preserved.
